title: AdaSpec: Adaptive Speculative Decoding for Fast, SLO-Aware Large Language Model Serving
technique: adaptive batch-level speculative length control from an efficiency model, request-level confidence prior verifier, SLO-aware efficiency estimator, built on vLLM

optimized_metrics.evidence: To measure the latency reduction effect, we use the speedup of end-to-end latency relative to autoregressive decoding as our primary metric.
it implements intelligent drafting and verification algorithms to maximize performance while ensuring high SLO attainment.
we set the SLO for TPOT as the P90 TPOT value of autoregressive decoding, employing the SLO attainment rate to assess service reliability

headline_claim.text: AdaSpec consistently meets SLOs and achieves substantial performance improvements, delivering up to 66% speedup compared to state-of-the-art speculative inference systems.

metric_definitions.definition_quote: we use the speedup of end-to-end latency relative to autoregressive decoding as our primary metric
the same throughput metric as used in LLM inference systems [19, 43], which is defined as Throughput = NAT / Tsd
metric_definitions.notes: internal controller objective: expected accepted tokens per speculative-step time; Alg. 3 returns estimated goodput, set to -1 if step time exceeds TPOT SLO

metric_definitions.definition_quote: we set the SLO for TPOT as the P90 TPOT value of autoregressive decoding, employing the SLO attainment rate to assess service reliability
metric_definitions.notes: SLO scale factor 0.8-1.2 on that TPOT

slo_spec: TPOT SLO = P90 TPOT of autoregressive decoding (scale 1), scale factor swept 0.8-1.2; attainment above 90% highlighted
load_regime: trace replay of three request-rate patterns (exponential growth, periodic, fluctuating; derived from Azure/Mooncake-style traces) plus batch-size sweep
tradeoff_acknowledged: longer speculative length raises speedup but degrades SLO satisfaction (pursuing higher speedup lowers SLO attainment)
workloads: SpecBench mixture (translation, summarization, QA, GSM8K, RAG, MT-bench), 480 requests
extractor_notes: Which of E2E speedup vs TPOT is the objective is slightly ambiguous: text says the focus is TPOT improvement but the primary metric is E2E speedup; SLO is on TPOT. Hardware/model details not fully read.
